protection_policy: Protect exact immutable images from every current app/job, every retained app revision, active execution, all referenced Git/worktree and archived release metadata, dependency image and recorded rollback. Resolve referenced mutable tags. Preserve recent and locked images. Check registry metadata and all current consumer images again before deletion.
recovery: Native ACR soft delete is enabled for30days before retirement. Verify a real restore on one eligible image and restore its original tag before continuing. All tags/digests and recovery deadline are retained. No blanket acr purge filter is used.
storage_savings: Soft-deleted images remain billable during30dayretention. Native autopurge releases unshared layers after retention. No sum of image sizes is claimed as uniquely recoverable storage.
